files.html: //! examples/geno_ppo - PPO on GENO, learned on the device in your hand. //! //! `getup_train` on the robot built from Geno's skeleton and mesh: standing armature on every joint, //! self-collision off, every reset rested on the floor, DReCon's watched and actuated bodies in Geno's //! names, and the dance from 5 s to 25 s (baked beside `geno_train`'s 5 s to 15 s). The action scale is stated, not //! inherited: 1.2 rad per unit, filtered (a fifth new, four fifths held) - see `robot_geno.student_scale`. //! //! What follows is `getup_train`'s own description. //! //! WHAT THIS IS //! //! The bench the whole tracking plan is measured on. A humanoid, a motion capture it should follow, //! a servo driving it toward the capture, and a small policy that learns - right here, from //! nothing - the corrections that keep it with the capture. Two motions to choose from: GETTING UP //! off the floor (five seconds, contact-rich, the hard one) and DANCING (twenty seconds of //! continuous balance). The characters are stepped on this device's CPU; the policy and value //! networks train on its GPU. Nothing is downloaded pre-trained: every weight this page uses was //! learned on the device it runs on, or uploaded by whoever runs it. //! //! THE NUMBER THAT MATTERS: MEAN TIME TO FAILURE //! //! Characters start at random points of the clip, so an episode can never outlast what is left of //! the clip - on the five-second get-up that averages two and a half seconds, which makes "how long //! did episodes last" top out well below perfect. So the page counts FAILURES - a character losing //! the reference - against the time characters were watched, and shows their ratio: how long a //! character tracks, on average, before it loses the reference. Running out of clip while still //! with it is survival, not failure. The servo alone is measured the same way, on this device, //! before learning starts; a perfect tracker's number grows without limit. //! //! HOW IT FITS A FRAME //! //! A batch of experience is too much for one frame, so each frame collects a FEW decisions //! (`Trainer.collect`), adapted to the frame time the device achieves, and goes back to drawing. //! When a batch is full, `Trainer.learn` dispatches the update to the GPU, which trains while the //! next batch is collected. The clips arrive BAKED (`zig build clip-bake`): retargeted, filtered, //! windowed and lifted offline into a few hundred kilobytes, so startup does no inverse kinematics. const std = @import("std"); const z = @import("zimr"); const zm = @import("zm"); const ui = z.ui; const rbt = z.robot; const rmj = z.robot_mjcf; const mjcf = z.mjcf; const codecs = z.codecs; const dance = z.robot_dance; const track = z.robot_track; const ppo_track = z.robot_ppo_track; const zn_mlp = @import("zn_mlp"); const Allocator = std.mem.Allocator; const Vec = zm.Vec; const Mat = zm.Mat; const Quat = zm.Quat; const Color = zm.Color; const Camera3D = zm.Camera3D; const vec = zm.vec; const qmul = zm.qmul; const quatToMat = zm.quatToMat; const float = zm.float; const mulMat = zm.mulMat; const translation = zm.translation; const scaling = zm.scaling; const splat = zm.splat; const Vec2 = zm.Vec2; const bufPrint = std.fmt.bufPrint; const ArrayList = std.ArrayList; const Trainer = ppo_track.Trainer(zn_mlp); const geno = z.robot_geno; const lab = z.robot_lab; const dance_zclip = @embedFile("dance.zclip"); const roboto_mono_ttf = @embedFile("roboto_mono_ttf"); /// The page's colours: the background, the character, the reference, the floor. const Look = struct { background: Color = .{ .r = 22, .g = 24, .b = 30, .a = 255 }, character: Color = .{ .r = 120, .g = 170, .b = 225, .a = 255 }, reference: Color = .{ .r = 86, .g = 92, .b = 104, .a = 255 }, floor: Color = .{ .r = 74, .g = 80, .b = 92, .a = 255 }, }; /// The floor's slab, as drawn: square, of some thickness, its top just below the grid - where the physics floor /// is, as near as the grid's lines allow without the two fighting for the same pixels. const Floor = struct { side: f32 = 16, thickness: f32 = 0.2, top: f32 = -0.005, }; /// The page's autosave (`autosaveIfDue`, `resumeFromAutosave`): how often, in seconds of training, and the largest /// training log a resume reads back - about 70 bytes a batch, so a week of batches. const Autosave = struct { interval_seconds: f32 = 300, most_log_bytes: usize = 16 << 20, }; /// The two motions, and what each needs. const Task = enum { getup, dance, fn label(task: Task) []const u8 { return switch (task) { .getup => "get-up", .dance => "dance", }; } fn clipBytes(task: Task) []const u8 { return switch (task) { .getup, .dance => dance_zclip, }; } /// The motion's name in `robot_geno`, whose PPO recipe the page trains with. fn motion(task: Task) lab.PpoMotion { return switch (task) { .getup => .getup, .dance => .dance, }; } /// The trainer's options: PPO's recipe on Geno, its defaults - the same settings a training run's `run.zon` /// starts from - with Geno's task, DReCon bodies and the motion's tag. fn options(task: Task, recipe: lab.PpoRecipe) ppo_track.Options { return recipe.options(task.motion()); } /// Geno has one motion baked so far: "switching" restarts the dance. fn other(task: Task) Task { _ = task; return .dance; } }; fn pipelineEntries(comptime M: type) [M.kernels.len]z.Compute(M).KernelWgsl { var table: [M.kernels.len]z.Compute(M).KernelWgsl = undefined; inline for (M.kernels, 0..) |name, i| { table[i] = .{ .name = name, .wgsl = @embedFile(name ++ "_wgsl") }; } return table; } /// Everything that changes as training goes, every field with a default - and assigned AS A WHOLE /// whenever training starts. That is the point: the app framework makes the `State` with /// `gpa.create`, which hands back uninitialised memory, so a default written on a `State` field is /// never applied. Grouped here, one assignment sets them all, and a field added later cannot be /// forgotten. const Progress = struct { /// Batches of history kept for the curve and the failure-rate window. const history_len: usize = 120; /// How many recent batches the mean time to failure is estimated over: a run log's window /// (`robot_lab.RunLog.window_batches`), the same for the trainer and the lab's curves. const window_batches: usize = lab.RunLog.window_batches; /// The mean times to failure the page times itself to, in seconds. The same marks for both motions: the measure /// does not depend on the clip's length, which is the point of it. const milestones = [_]f32{ 2.0, 5.0, 10.0, 20.0 }; /// Decisions collected per frame, adapted to the frame time the device achieves. per_frame: u32 = 1, last: ppo_track.Stats = .{ .decisions = 0, .steps = 0, .mean_reward = 0, .episodes = 0, .mean_episode = 0 }, failed: ?[]const u8 = null, /// What the weights buttons last did, shown under them. status: [96]u8 = @splat(0), status_len: usize = 0, /// Seconds spent training since this motion was chosen (or since weights were loaded). training_seconds: f32 = 0, /// When the mean time to failure first reached each milestone, in training seconds; 0 until. milestone_seconds: [milestones.len]f32 = @splat(0), /// Per batch: physics steps watched, failures among them, and whether the assist was on. exposure: [history_len]u64 = @splat(0), failures: [history_len]u32 = @splat(0), assisted: [history_len]bool = @splat(false), history_count: usize = 0, /// Whether this run has autosaved yet, and the training seconds at the last autosave (`autosaveIfDue`). has_autosaved: bool = false, autosaved_at_seconds: f32 = 0, /// The servo alone, measured the same way before any training: decisions left to run, then /// what it managed. servo_left: u32 = 96, servo_exposure: u64 = 0, servo_failures: u32 = 0, }; const State = struct { font: z.Font, ui_host: z.UiHost, cam: z.OrbitCamera, sphere: z.Mesh, cube: z.Mesh, cylinder: z.Mesh, transform: [1]Mat, doc: codecs.xml.Document, robot: mjcf.Robot, imported: rmj.Imported, /// The reference's pose, posed each frame by forward kinematics, for drawing. ghost: rbt.Data, gpa: Allocator, pipe: z.Compute(zn_mlp), task: Task, clip: dance.Clip, trainer: *Trainer, /// Exactly-zero actions for the whole fleet: the servo alone. zero_actions: []f32, progress: Progress, /// The training log, one CSV line a batch (`lab.RunLog`), saved with each autosave. training_log: ArrayList(u8), /// PPO's recipe on Geno as the page trains it: its defaults, the settings a training run's `run.zon` starts from. recipe: lab.PpoRecipe, look: Look, floor: Floor, autosave: Autosave, }; /// Physics steps per second of the page's Geno: what turns steps watched into seconds of character-time. fn physicsStepsPerSecond(model: *const rbt.Model) f32 { return 1.0 / model.opt.timestep; } /// The recent past, as the milestones see it. const Recent = struct { /// Mean time to failure over the window; null if nothing in it failed. mttf: ?f32, /// Every batch in the window ran with the assist at zero - the real task. unassisted: bool, /// The window is full: enough batches to trust the number. full: bool, }; /// The last `Progress.window_batches` batches: their mean time to failure, and whether they count. fn recentWindow(p: *const Progress, physics_steps_per_second: f32) Recent { const count: usize = @min(p.history_count, Progress.window_batches); var exposure: u64 = 0; var failures: u64 = 0; var unassisted: bool = true; for (0..count) |i| { const index: usize = (p.history_count - 1 - i) % Progress.history_len; exposure += p.exposure[index]; failures += p.failures[index]; unassisted = unassisted and !p.assisted[index]; } return .{ .mttf = if (count == 0) null else ppo_track.secondsToFailure(exposure, failures, physics_steps_per_second), .unassisted = unassisted, .full = count == Progress.window_batches, }; } // ---- Training unattended ---- // // A night's training must survive what can happen while nobody watches: a crash, a restart, a closed window. So // every few minutes the page saves the newest weights and the training log as saved values (`z.saveValue`) - in // the browser's storage on the web, as files in the program's folder under the user's application data natively // (`%APPDATA%\zimr\geno_ppo` on Windows) - and at start-up it carries on from them without asking, since there may // be no one to ask. "Start over" discards them. // // start-up: autosave found, same network and motion? -> resume from its batch else -> train from scratch // training: every 5 minutes of training -> save the weights, then the log // morning: <motion>.weights and <motion>.log.csv -> the newest weights, and one line per batch /// What the weights buttons and the autosave last did, shown under the buttons. fn setStatus(s: *State, comptime fmt: []const u8, args: anytype) void { const written: []const u8 = bufPrint(&s.progress.status, fmt, args) catch s.progress.status[0..0]; s.progress.status_len = written.len; } /// The saved value's key for this motion's autosave: `<motion>.weights` or `<motion>.log.csv`. fn autosaveKey(task: Task, comptime suffix: []const u8, buffer: []u8) []const u8 { return bufPrint(buffer, "{s}" ++ suffix, .{task.label()}) catch suffix; } /// Saves the newest weights, then the training log: after the first batch, then whenever /// `interval_seconds` of training have passed since the last time. Whether it saved. fn autosaveIfDue( gpa: Allocator, trainer: *Trainer, task: Task, training_log: []const u8, interval_seconds: f32, progress: *Progress, ) !bool { // Nothing to save before the first batch has trained. if (trainer.iterations == 0) { return false; } const seconds_since_autosave: f32 = progress.training_seconds - progress.autosaved_at_seconds; const is_due: bool = !progress.has_autosaved or seconds_since_autosave >= interval_seconds; // The parameters read back must be the update's whose counters are saved beside them: a later frame saves // when they are not yet (`isReadbackCurrent`) - a page cannot wait for a readback, which lands between frames. if (!is_due or !trainer.isReadbackCurrent()) { return false; } const weights_bytes: []u8 = try trainer.exportWeights(gpa); defer gpa.free(weights_bytes); var key_buffer: [48]u8 = undefined; z.saveValue(autosaveKey(task, ".weights", &key_buffer), weights_bytes); z.saveValue(autosaveKey(task, ".log.csv", &key_buffer), training_log); progress.has_autosaved = true; progress.autosaved_at_seconds = progress.training_seconds; return true; } /// What `resumeFromAutosave` found. const ResumeOutcome = union(enum) { /// No autosave of this motion. nothing_saved, /// An autosave the trainer refused - another network's shape, another motion's tag - by the error's name. refused: []const u8, /// Carried on from the autosave's batch. resumed, }; /// Carries on from this motion's autosave, if there is one this network accepts: its weights - and with them its /// batch count, Adam's state and the normaliser's statistics - and its training log. Out of memory fails the start: /// a log not carried on would be overwritten, empty, at the next autosave. fn resumeFromAutosave( gpa: Allocator, trainer: *Trainer, task: Task, training_log: *ArrayList(u8), most_log_bytes: usize, ) Allocator.Error!ResumeOutcome { var key_buffer: [48]u8 = undefined; const weights_buffer: []u8 = try gpa.alloc(u8, trainer.weightsByteCount()); defer gpa.free(weights_buffer); const saved_weights: []u8 = z.loadValue(autosaveKey(task, ".weights", &key_buffer), weights_buffer) orelse return .nothing_saved; trainer.importWeights(saved_weights) catch |err| { return .{ .refused = @errorName(err) }; }; const log_buffer: []u8 = try gpa.alloc(u8, most_log_bytes); defer gpa.free(log_buffer); if (z.loadValue(autosaveKey(task, ".log.csv", &key_buffer), log_buffer)) |saved_log| { training_log.clearRetainingCapacity(); try training_log.appendSlice(gpa, saved_log); } return .resumed; } /// Begin training on a motion from scratch: its baked clip, a fresh trainer, fresh progress. /// `replace` says whether a previous motion's clip and trainer must be released first. fn startTask(s: *State, task: Task, replace: bool) !void { if (replace) { s.trainer.deinit(); s.clip.deinit(); } const m: *rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; s.task = task; s.clip = try dance.Clip.fromBytes(s.gpa, task.clipBytes()); // The fleet copies this list, so a local array is fine here. const clips = [_]*const dance.Clip{&s.clip}; const trainer_options: ppo_track.Options = task.options(s.recipe); s.trainer = try Trainer.init(s.gpa, &s.pipe, m, s.imported.names, &clips, trainer_options); s.progress = .{}; s.training_log.clearRetainingCapacity(); try s.training_log.appendSlice(s.gpa, lab.RunLog.header); } /// Discards this motion's autosave and log, and trains from scratch. fn startOver(s: *State) !void { var key_buffer: [48]u8 = undefined; z.removeValue(autosaveKey(s.task, ".weights", &key_buffer)); z.removeValue(autosaveKey(s.task, ".log.csv", &key_buffer)); try startTask(s, s.task, true); setStatus(s, "started over", .{}); } fn initState(gpa: Allocator, f: *z.Frame, s: *State) !void { s.progress = .{}; s.gpa = gpa; s.training_log = .empty; s.font = try z.loadFont(f, gpa, roboto_mono_ttf, 16); s.ui_host = z.UiHost.init(gpa, s.font); s.cam = z.OrbitCamera.init(vec(0.0, 0.7, 0), 4.0); s.sphere = try z.genMeshSphere(gpa, 1.0, 10, 8); s.cube = try z.genMeshCube(gpa, 1.0, 1.0, 1.0); s.cylinder = try z.genMeshCylinder(gpa, 1.0, 1.0, 16, 2); s.transform = .{zm.identity()}; // The robot, exactly as every test in the tracking stack builds it. s.doc = try codecs.xml.parse(gpa, z.robot_geno_model, null); s.robot = try mjcf.readRobot(gpa, &s.doc); for (s.robot.joints) |*joint| { if (joint.kind == .ball) { joint.armature = geno.standing_armature; } } const physics_options: rbt.Options = geno.physicsOptions(); s.imported = try rmj.build(gpa, &s.robot, physics_options); const m: *rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; s.ghost = try rbt.Data.init(gpa, m); s.recipe = .{}; s.look = .{}; s.floor = .{}; s.autosave = .{}; const actions_per_character: usize = track.actionSize(m); const zero_action_count: usize = s.recipe.envs * actions_per_character; s.zero_actions = try gpa.alloc(f32, zero_action_count); @memset(s.zero_actions, 0.0); // The networks live on the GPU; the characters on the CPU. s.pipe = try z.Compute(zn_mlp).initGpu(gpa, f.gpu.device, f.gpu.queue, &pipelineEntries(zn_mlp)); // The profiler times every stage of every physics step, each reading a crossing from wasm into // JS - about 1,300 a frame here, for a profile nobody is looking at. Frozen, its zones return // before touching the clock. z.profiler.freeze(); try startTask(s, .getup, false); // Carry on from the last run's autosave, if any; the servo is still measured first. const most_log_bytes: usize = s.autosave.most_log_bytes; const outcome: ResumeOutcome = try resumeFromAutosave(gpa, s.trainer, s.task, &s.training_log, most_log_bytes); switch (outcome) { .nothing_saved => {}, .refused => |reason| setStatus(s, "autosave refused: {s}", .{reason}), .resumed => setStatus(s, "resumed from batch {d}", .{s.trainer.iterations}), } } fn deinit(gpa: Allocator, s: *State) void { // The trainer first - it holds the networks on the GPU host - and then the host itself, which // owns the buffers, bind groups and compute pipelines. s.trainer.deinit(); s.pipe.deinit(); s.clip.deinit(); gpa.free(s.zero_actions); s.ghost.deinit(); s.training_log.deinit(gpa); s.imported.deinit(); s.robot.deinit(); s.doc.deinit(); z.unloadMesh(gpa, s.cylinder); z.unloadMesh(gpa, s.cube); z.unloadMesh(gpa, s.sphere); s.ui_host.deinit(); z.unloadFont(gpa, s.font); } /// The servo alone - the policy's actions held at exactly zero - on the very fleet that is about /// to train, counted the same way as the policy: steps watched against failures among them. Done /// before learning starts, so it measures the servo and nothing else. fn measureServo(s: *State) void { const p: *Progress = &s.progress; const fleet: *track.Fleet = s.trainer.env.fleet; // The servo ALONE: the root assist, which would hold up characters the servo would lose, is off while measuring. const scheduled_assist: f32 = fleet.options.task.gains.assist; fleet.options.task.gains.assist = 0; defer fleet.options.task.gains.assist = scheduled_assist; const take: u32 = @min(p.servo_left, p.per_frame); for (0..take) |_| { for (0..2) |_| { _ = fleet.step(s.zero_actions); p.servo_exposure += fleet.failures.len; for (fleet.failures) |lost| { if (lost) { p.servo_failures += 1; } } } } p.servo_left -= take; } /// One finished batch into the history, and the milestones it may have reached. fn recordBatch(s: *State, stats: ppo_track.Stats) void { const p: *Progress = &s.progress; p.last = stats; const index: usize = p.history_count % Progress.history_len; p.exposure[index] = stats.exposure; p.failures[index] = stats.failures; p.assisted[index] = stats.assist > 0; p.history_count += 1; const steps_per_second: f32 = physicsStepsPerSecond(&s.imported.model); const recent: Recent = recentWindow(p, steps_per_second); // Only whole windows of unassisted batches count: the bar is the real task. A window with no // failures at all has passed every milestone. if (recent.full and recent.unassisted) { const seconds: f32 = recent.mttf orelse 1.0e9; for (Progress.milestones, &p.milestone_seconds) |mark, *when| { if (when.* == 0 and seconds >= mark) { when.* = p.training_seconds; } } } } /// Hand the newest weights to the Save overlay, named by motion and by how many batches trained /// them - so the newest file on the phone is obvious by its name alone. fn offerWeights(s: *State) void { const bytes: []u8 = s.trainer.exportWeights(s.gpa) catch return; defer s.gpa.free(bytes); var name_buffer: [64]u8 = undefined; const batches: u64 = s.trainer.iterations; const name: []const u8 = bufPrint(&name_buffer, "{s}_ppo_b{d}.weights", .{ s.task.label(), batches }) catch return; z.userfile.offerDownload(bytes, name); } /// Weights the user picked: carried on from if they fit this network AND this motion, refused by /// name if not. fn takeUploads(s: *State) void { while (z.userfile.pendingCount() > 0) { const size: u32 = z.userfile.nextSize(); const bytes: []u8 = s.gpa.alloc(u8, size) catch { z.userfile.discardNext(); return; }; defer s.gpa.free(bytes); _ = z.userfile.readNext(bytes); if (s.trainer.importWeights(bytes)) |_| { // A fresh record from here: the servo stands, the history and milestones restart. const servo_exposure: u64 = s.progress.servo_exposure; const servo_failures: u32 = s.progress.servo_failures; s.progress = .{}; s.progress.servo_left = 0; s.progress.servo_exposure = servo_exposure; s.progress.servo_failures = servo_failures; setStatus(s, "loaded batch {d}", .{s.trainer.iterations}); offerWeights(s); } else |err| { setStatus(s, "refused: {s}", .{@errorName(err)}); } } } /// The failure rate over time, in plain ASCII - a density ramp every font has - one character a /// batch: taller is longer between losses, relative to the best window so far. fn drawCurve(u: ui.Ui, p: *const Progress, steps_per_second: f32) void { const shown: usize = @min(p.history_count, 32); if (shown == 0) { return; } const ramp: []const u8 = ".:-=+*#%@"; var values: [32]f32 = undefined; var top: f32 = 0.1; for (0..shown) |i| { // Each character: that batch's own exposure over its failures, capped so one lucky batch // with no failures does not flatten the rest. const index: usize = (p.history_count - shown + i) % Progress.history_len; const batch_exposure: u64 = p.exposure[index]; const batch_failures: u32 = p.failures[index]; const batch_seconds: ?f32 = ppo_track.secondsToFailure(batch_exposure, batch_failures, steps_per_second); const seconds: f32 = @min(batch_seconds orelse 30.0, 30.0); values[i] = seconds; top = @max(top, seconds); } var line: [32]u8 = undefined; for (0..shown) |i| { const step: usize = @trunc(values[i] / top * float(ramp.len - 1)); line[i] = ramp[@min(ramp.len - 1, step)]; } u.text("{s}", .{line[0..shown]}); } /// The numbers that say whether it is learning. Returns whether the pointer belongs to the panel, /// so the camera leaves it alone. fn drawPanel(s: *State, f: *z.Frame) bool { const u: ui.Ui = s.ui_host.begin(f); const steps_per_second: f32 = physicsStepsPerSecond(&s.imported.model); const captured: bool = u.wantCaptureMouse(); // Compact on purpose: on a portrait phone the canvas is short, and a window that auto-expands // past it hides its own last lines. if (u.window("tracking, PPO", .{ .initial_pos = .{ 4, 4 }, .initial_size = .{ 330, 160 } })) |window| { defer window.close(); const p: *Progress = &s.progress; if (p.failed) |why| { u.text("stopped: {s}", .{why}); } const trainer: *Trainer = s.trainer; u.text("{s}: {d} batches {d}k steps {d}/f", .{ s.task.label(), trainer.iterations, trainer.steps / 1000, p.per_frame, }); if (p.servo_left > 0) { u.text("measuring the servo alone...", .{}); } else { const recent: Recent = recentWindow(p, steps_per_second); const servo_exposure: u64 = p.servo_exposure; const servo_failures: u32 = p.servo_failures; const servo_seconds: ?f32 = ppo_track.secondsToFailure(servo_exposure, servo_failures, steps_per_second); const servo: z.Str(24) = if (servo_seconds) |seconds| .print("{d:.1}s", .{seconds}) else .print("never", .{}); if (p.history_count == 0) { u.text("servo loses it every {s}", .{servo.slice()}); } else if (recent.mttf) |seconds| { u.text("loses it every {d:.1}s servo {s}", .{ seconds, servo.slice() }); } else { u.text("no losses lately! servo {s}", .{servo.slice()}); } } if (p.last.assist > 0) { u.text("assist {d:.2} - fading, milestones wait", .{p.last.assist}); } // Minutes of training to each milestone: the number every method in the plan is judged by. var marks: [64]u8 = undefined; var at: usize = 0; for (Progress.milestones, p.milestone_seconds) |mark, when| { const piece: []const u8 = if (when > 0) bufPrint(marks[at..], "{d:.0}s@{d:.1}m ", .{ mark, when / 60.0 }) catch "" else bufPrint(marks[at..], "{d:.0}s@-- ", .{mark}) catch ""; at += piece.len; } u.text("{s}", .{marks[0..at]}); _ = u.button("save", .{}); const save_min: Vec2 = u.getItemRectMin(); const save_max: Vec2 = u.getItemRectMax(); z.userfile.setSaveRect(save_min[0], save_min[1], save_max[0] - save_min[0], save_max[1] - save_min[1]); u.sameLine(.{}); _ = u.button("load", .{}); const load_min: Vec2 = u.getItemRectMin(); const load_max: Vec2 = u.getItemRectMax(); z.userfile.setPickerRect( load_min[0], load_min[1], load_max[0] - load_min[0], load_max[1] - load_min[1], ".weights,application/octet-stream", ); u.sameLine(.{}); const label: z.Str(32) = .print("-> {s}", .{s.task.other().label()}); if (u.button(label.slice(), .{})) { startTask(s, s.task.other(), true) catch |err| { p.failed = @errorName(err); }; } u.sameLine(.{}); if (u.button("start over", .{})) { startOver(s) catch |err| { p.failed = @errorName(err); }; } if (p.status_len > 0) { u.text("{s}", .{p.status[0..p.status_len]}); } drawCurve(u, p, steps_per_second); } return captured; } /// A point of the robot's world, where z is up, in the drawing's, where y is up: the quarter turn about x that /// `zm.zUpToYUp` makes, (x, y, z) to (x, z, -y). fn yUpOf(z_up_point: Vec) Vec { return vec(z_up_point[0], z_up_point[2], -z_up_point[1]); } fn drawRobot(s: *State, gl: *z.WgpuGl, d: *const rbt.Data, tint: Color) void { const m: *const rbt.Model = &s.imported.model; const to_y_up: Mat = zm.zUpToYUp(); for (0..m.ngeom) |g| { const body: u32 = m.geom_body[g]; const translation_drawn: Mat = mulMat(to_y_up, world_translation); const place: Mat = mulMat(translation_drawn, world_rot); switch (m.geom_shape[g]) { .sphere => |sph| { const radius: f32 = sph.radius; s.transform[0] = mulMat(place, scaling(radius, radius, radius)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &s.sphere, &s.transform, tint); }, .box => |b| { const size: Vec = b.half_extent * splat(2.0); s.transform[0] = mulMat(place, scaling(size[0], size[1], size[2])); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &s.cube, &s.transform, tint); }, .capsule => |cap| { // The cylinder mesh rises from its base: its base moved down half the capsule's length, then the // mesh stretched to the capsule's radius and whole length. const capsule_length: f32 = 2.0 * cap.half_height; const base_lowered: Mat = mulMat(place, translation(0, -cap.half_height, 0)); s.transform[0] = mulMat(base_lowered, scaling(cap.radius, capsule_length, cap.radius)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, &s.cylinder, &s.transform, tint); }, else => {}, } } } /// The floor's slab: the unit cube's center half its thickness below the top, then the cube stretched to the slab. fn drawFloor( gl: *z.WgpuGl, cube: *z.Mesh, transform: *[1]Mat, floor: Floor, tint: Color, ) void { const center_height: f32 = floor.top - 0.5 * floor.thickness; const center: Mat = mulMat(zm.zUpToYUp(), translation(0, 0, center_height)); transform[0] = mulMat(center, scaling(floor.side, floor.side, floor.thickness)); z.drawMeshInstanced(gl, cube, transform, tint); } if (s.trainer.collect(p.per_frame)) { const stats: ppo_track.Stats = s.trainer.learn(); recordBatch(s, stats); const training_minutes: f32 = p.training_seconds / 60.0; lab.RunLog.appendLine(s.gpa, &s.training_log, s.trainer.iterations, training_minutes, stats) catch |err| { p.failed = @errorName(err); }; offerWeights(s); } // Checked every frame, not only as a batch ends: the update a batch dispatches is read back a frame or two // later, and only then are the parameters and the counters beside them of the same moment. const log_text: []const u8 = s.training_log.items; const interval_seconds: f32 = s.autosave.interval_seconds; const has_autosaved: bool = autosaveIfDue( s.gpa, s.trainer, s.task, log_text, interval_seconds, p, ) catch |err| saved: { p.failed = @errorName(err); break :saved false; }; if (has_autosaved) { setStatus(s, "autosaved batch {d}", .{s.trainer.iterations}); } } takeUploads(s); z.clearViewport(f, s.look.background); defer s.ui_host.render(f); const captured: bool = drawPanel(s, f); // The camera follows training character 0, whom the dance carries around the room: it orbits his root. const root_body: usize = 1; const shown_character: *const rbt.Data = &s.trainer.env.fleet.data[0]; const root_position: Vec = shown_character.body_xpos[root_body]; s.cam.target = yUpOf(root_position); const cam: Camera3D = s.cam.update(f, captured, .{ .min_distance = 1.5, .max_distance = 10.0 }); z.beginMode3D(gl, cam); z.drawGrid(gl, 20, 0.5); drawFloor(gl, &s.cube, &s.transform, s.floor, s.look.floor); // The reference, where training character 0 should be; then the character itself. const fleet: *track.Fleet = s.trainer.env.fleet; const frame: usize = @min(@as(usize, fleet.frame[0]), s.clip.frame_count - 1); @memcpy(s.ghost.pos, s.clip.pose(frame)); s.ghost.stage = .stale; rbt.kinematics(m, &s.ghost); drawRobot(s, gl, &s.ghost, s.look.reference); drawRobot(s, gl, &fleet.data[0], s.look.character); z.endMode3D(gl); } pub const app: z.AppSpec(State) = .{ .config = .{ .window = .{ .title = "zimr - getting up, learned on this device", .width = 960, .height = 540, .scale_mode = .responsive, .depth_format = .depth24_plus, }, }, .init = initState, .memory = .managed, .deinit = deinit, .update = update, };
